what: a loft from a rectangular ring (two nested rectangles) to a circular ring (two concentric circles) 30 mm above: a hollow transition piece
method: no closed form for the ring-to-ring pairing, so only invariants are graded: the loft succeeds as one closed valid solid (outer wall, hole wall and two caps), and since every ruling joins a point of one section to a point of the other, the solid lies in the hull of both sections: bbox x +-20, y +-15 (the 40 x 30 outer rectangle), z 0 to 30.
